skill.description: Turn YouTube transcripts into evidence-linked summaries, threads, or blog drafts.

memory.responsibility: Retain youtube url plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform transcript and timestamps into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through claim and topic extractor while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose source discovery and evidence-processing capabilities that preserve provenance and uncertainty.

stages: Resolve the canonical video and metadata
Fetch or derive timestamped transcript text
Identify sections claims examples and quotes
Adapt into thread or blog form

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
